PaddleOCR mobile licence reader

SDK: @paddleocr/paddleocr-js 0.4.2, PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR, Apache License 2.0.
Models: PP-OCRv5_mobile_det and en_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec, official PaddleOCR
ONNX inference archives. Original URLs and SHA-256 hashes: manifest.json.
Official project: https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR
PaddleOCR license: PADDLE-LICENSE.txt.

Runtime: Microsoft ONNX Runtime Web 1.24.3, MIT License (ONNX-LICENSE.txt).
OpenCV.js dependency: @techstark/opencv-js (Apache License 2.0), included
through the official SDK. OpenCV: https://opencv.org/license/

Local integration bundles a CPU-only worker, pins model versions, groups
detected text by geometric position and maps labelled licence fields.
No model training or proprietary scanner implementation is included.
